page.overview:
What is Flickering Realms?

The Flickering Realms is a fictional dimension created by Marvel Comics, which first appeared in Spider-Woman Vol 1 #44 "Vengeance!". It is known for being the realm of Chthon, as well as inhabiting the N'Garai.

The Flickering Realms (aka, the Dimension of the Darkhold) was created by the Elder God known as Chthon. The dimension has no map, due to its constantly changing landscape. One may cross stones, then swamps, followed by snow, and then sands; in which the snow burns like fire and the stones bleed. The only thing that is constant in the dimension is danger. It also contains the dimension of the N'Garai, which is full of demons.
